dataset: DeepFashion In-Shop official train identities only
split: exclude singleton train identities, class-disjoint 90/10 split at seed 179019; alternate original-order images within each validation identity into gallery then query
shared_projection: centered PCA-128 fitted only on normalized original L/14 fit-identity embeddings and held fixed across all three arms
advancement_rule: Rank512 is eligible for a full-pipeline screen only if its class-bootstrap 95% lower bound versus original is at least -0.002 Recall@1 for both the 130-byte packed and upstream-prefix scorers; exact_fused requires maximum absolute descriptor difference no more than 0.000005 and no material retrieval regression. This is a train-only diagnostic gate, not a SOTA claim.
prohibitions: no selection from CUB or Cars transfer outcomes
no p99 or SOTA claim from this screen
